D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ [GLORIA] EXERC ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Trier mint Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17, possibly RIC volume 7 no. 527, issue of 330-331. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA] EXERC ITVS. In exergue: TRP. Diameter: 18.3mm, Weight: 2.07gms, die axis: 6
